description: Start (or replace) your running timer on a subtask. There is at most one running timer per user; starting a new one replaces any existing. Stop it later with stop_timer to create a Draft time entry, or cancel it with cancel_timer to discard it. Supply subtask_id.

description.description: Optional description of the work being tracked.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

subtask_id.description: Id of the subtask to track time against.

name: start_timer
